description: Matching test set of feature 005 (research.md R-05, ADR-014 D4, SC-004). Each case: the lookup input, the MusicBrainz exchanges in the order the client makes them (replay them in order with httpx.MockTransport) and the expected outcome.
provenance: Self-written by the qa agent in the MusicBrainz WS/2 JSON shape, trimmed to the fields StemStudio reads. Identifiers c8361f8a-ece3-4ad0-a5a6-4bb6d06083b9, e389b7df-862d-3d91-a612-acca150f6e71, 8292bf44-2dd1-4bad-8019-276ec38f28e7, 057247bb-7a93-4654-9a7d-4cb9abaf5c5c, ISRCs USEVI9692306/USUAN1400011 and the lengths 258.1/261.9/125.0 s come from the 2026-11-15 feasibility check (research.md F-01/F-02; MusicBrainz core data is CC0). Every other id is synthetic (UUIDv5 in namespace 5a1d3c1e-0c5e-4d9b-9a57-57e3575701d0) and every artist other than Metallica and Kevin MacLeod is fictional. Not a recording of live traffic; see README.md.

rules.titleEquality: NFKC, casefold, '&' -> 'and', punctuation removed, whitespace collapsed (research.md R-04)
rules.artistSimilarity: >= 0.9 on the normalised names (rapidfuzz ratio / 100); every case is far from the threshold (either equal after normalisation or < 0.6)
rules.selection: closest duration; ties prefer an official Album release group (no secondary types) with the earliest date
rules.queryMatching: request.query is the expected Lucene query (escaping per case 'lucene-special-characters'); a replaying transport may match by kind and order only
